name: demo_full_cycle
description: Full assurance lifecycle. The motor wears from tick 5 and settles at 12% wear (a stable worn state): Assured -> Flagged -> Nullified. At tick 60 the operator requests recalibration; the platform splits the flagged-period data by time, seals both parts, hands only the earlier part to the twin's owner, re-verifies and validates the recalibrated twin on the held-out later part, and issues a new assurance version. At tick 64 the recalibrated, semi-autonomous motor twin recommends raising the supply voltage to bring the compressor's drive speed back into its assured range; a human operator approves at tick 65; it is executed at tick 66; ticks 67-71 are checked. The compressor stays Flagged (status is sticky), so the system twin stays Flagged with that traced reason.

objective.description: Bring the compressor's drive speed back into its assured range
